name: agents-prompt
description: High-agency senior software engineering workflow for agentic coding environments. Use when building, refactoring, debugging, architecting, or extending production software collaboratively with an AI coding agent. Optimized for side-by-side human+AI development where the AI acts as an implementation partner while the human remains the decision-maker. Emphasizes clean architecture, maintainable code, fast iteration, safe refactoring, debugging discipline, and production-grade engineering practices across full-stack systems.
